core_rules.constraint: Relate the supplied evidence directly to the stated mean response-time comparison: A = 120 ms and B = 90 ms. Retain the mean response-time metric, ms units, same hardware and workload, 10 runs for each system, and the qualification that the result is limited to these test conditions.

adjustable_rules.constraint: Use much whitespace while preserving the complete A/B evidence relationship and all interpretation-critical labels, units, shared test assumptions, run count, and applicability limitation. Whitespace must not turn the numerical evidence into isolated decoration.
